summary.text: Charity Clark is the incumbent Democratic Attorney General of Vermont, seeking a third two-year term. A former assistant attorney general and chief of staff to a previous attorney general, she was first elected in 2022 and re-elected in 2024. Her office has joined or brought 70 cases against the Trump administration, along with consumer-protection and child-safety actions.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Burr & Burton Academy, the University of Vermont and Boston College Law School; began her legal career in 2005 at Downs Rachlin Martin in Burlington and later Orrick in New York City.
Was an assistant attorney general in the Public Protection Division from 2014 and chief of staff to Attorney General T.J. Donovan from 2018 to 2022.
Elected Attorney General in 2022 and re-elected in 2024; the first woman elected Vermont Attorney General, according to her campaign.

sources.title: Attorney General Clark Sues to Block Trump Administration's Public Charge Rule
